arxiv-2101-05806.title: Exploration of Visual Features and their weighted-additive fusion for Video Captioning
arxiv-2101-05806.creator: Praveen S V, Akhilesh Bharadwaj, Harsh Raj, Janhavi Dadhania, Ganesh Samarth C.A, Nikhil Pareek, S R M Prasanna
arxiv-2101-05806.description: Abstract Video captioning is a popular task that challenges models to describe events in videos using natural language. In this work, we investigate the ability of various visual feature representations derived from state-of-the-art convolutional neural networks to capture high-level semantic context.

arxiv-2209-02732.description: Abstract Study of the strongly correlated states in van der Waals heterostructures is one of the central topics in modern condensed matter physics. Among these, the rhombohedral trilayer graphene (RTG) occupies a prominent place since it hosts a variety of interaction-driven phases, with the metallic ones yielding exotic superconducting orders upon doping [H. arxiv-2307-09886.title: A reinforcement learning approach for VQA validation: an application to diabetic macular edema grading
arxiv-2307-09886.creator: Tatiana Fountoukidou, Raphael Sznitman
arxiv-2307-09886.description: Abstract Recent advances in machine learning models have greatly increased the performance of automated methods in medical image analysis. However, the internal functioning of such models is largely hidden, which hinders their integration in clinical practice. Explainability and trust are viewed as important aspects of modern methods, for the latter’s widespread use in clinical communities.

arxiv-2403-11008.title: MASSM: An End-to-End Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Anatomy Statistical Shape Modeling Directly From Images
arxiv-2403-11008.creator: Janmesh Ukey, Tushar Kataria, Shireen Y. Elhabian
arxiv-2403-11008.description: Abstract Statistical Shape Modeling (SSM) effectively analyzes anatomical variations within populations but is limited by the need for manual localization and segmentation, which relies on scarce medical expertise. Recent advances in deep learning have provided a promising approach that automatically generates statistical representations (as point distribution models or PDMs) from unsegmented images.

arxiv-2404-02645.title: One Stack to Rule them All: To Drive Automated Vehicles, and Reach for the 4 th Level
arxiv-2404-02645.creator: Sven Ochs, Jens Doll, Daniel Grimm, Tobias Fleck, Marc Heinrich, Stefan Orf, Albert Schotschneider, Helen Gremmelmaier, Rupert Polley, Svetlana Pavlitska, Maximilian Zipfl, Helen Schneider, Ferdinand Mütsch, Daniel Bogdoll, Florian Kuhnt, Philip Schörner, Marc René Zofka, J. Marius Zöllner
arxiv-2404-02645.description: Abstract Most automated driving functions are designed for a specific task or vehicle. Most often, the underlying architecture is fixed to specific algorithms to increase performance. Therefore, it is not possible to deploy new modules and algorithms easily. In this paper, we present our automated driving stack which combines both scalability and adaptability.

arxiv-2407-11668.title: Learning to Make Keypoints Sub-Pixel Accurate
arxiv-2407-11668.creator: Shinjeong Kim, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Barath
arxiv-2407-11668.description: Abstract This work addresses the challenge of sub-pixel accuracy in detecting 2D local features, a cornerstone problem in computer vision. Despite the advancements brought by neural network-based methods like SuperPoint and ALIKED, these modern approaches lag behind classical ones such as SIFT in keypoint localization accuracy due to their lack of sub-pixel precision.

arxiv-2409-14283.title: Flag-Proxy Networks: Overcoming the Architectural, Scheduling and Decoding Obstacles of Quantum LDPC Codes
arxiv-2409-14283.creator: Suhas Vittal, Ali Javadi-Abhari, Andrew W. Cross, Lev S. Bishop, Moinuddin Qureshi
arxiv-2409-14283.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Suhas Vittal, Ali Javadi-Abhari, Andrew W. Cross, Lev S. Bishop, Moinuddin Qureshi. Quantum error correction is necessary for achieving exponential speedups on important applications. The planar surface code has remained the most studied error-correcting code for the last two decades because of its relative simplicity. However, encoding a singular logical qubit with the planar surface code requires physical qubits quadratic in the code distance ( d d ), making it space-inefficient for the large-distance codes necessary for promising applications.

arxiv-2505-11825.title: Bootstrapping Diffusion: Diffusion Model Training Leveraging Partial and Corrupted Data
arxiv-2505-11825.creator: Xudong Ma, San Francisco, California, xma@ieee.org
arxiv-2505-11825.description: Abstract Training diffusion models requires large datasets. However, acquiring large volumes of high-quality data can be challenging, for example, collecting large numbers of high-resolution images and long videos. On the other hand, there are many complementary data that are usually considered corrupted or partial, such as low-resolution images and short videos.

pmc-10557064.creator: Kieran Griffiths, Jake L Greenfield, Nathan R Halcovitch, Matthew J Fuchter, John M Griffin
pmc-10557064.description: A series of arylazopyrazole-loaded metal–organic frameworks were synthesized with the general formula Zn2(BDC)2(DABCO)(AAP)x (BDC = 1,4-benzenedicarboxylate; DABCO = 1,4-diazabicyclo-[2.2.2]octane; AAP = arylazopyrazole guest). pmc-10594278.title: Diagnostic accuracy of antibiograms in predicting the risk of antimicrobial resistance for individual patients
pmc-10594278.creator: Shinya Hasegawa, Jonas Church, Eli Perencevich, Michihiko Goto
pmc-10594278.description: Background: Many clinical guidelines recommend that clinicians should use antibiograms to decide on empiric antimicrobial therapy. However, antibiograms aggregate epidemiologic data without consideration for any other factors that may affect the risk of antimicrobial resistance (AMR), and little is known about an antibiogram’s reliability in predicting antimicrobial susceptibility.

pmc-11600653.title: Efficacy of ChatGPT in Educating Patients and Clinicians About Skin Toxicities Associated With Cancer Treatment
pmc-11600653.creator: Annie Chang, Jade Young, Andrew Para, Angela Lamb, Nicholas Gulati
pmc-11600653.description: This study investigates the application of ChatGPT, an artificial intelligence tool, in providing information on skin toxicities associated with cancer treatments, highlighting that while ChatGPT can serve as a valuable resource for clinicians, its use for patient education requires careful consideration due to the complex nature of the information provided.

pmc-11712183.title: How value‐based healthcare can improve the work of memory clinics
pmc-11712183.creator: Anna R. Schönberger, Annika Steinmetz, Ann‐Katrin Schild, Lucrezia Hausner, Gloria Spielmann‐Benson, Lutz Frölich, Frank Jessen
pmc-11712183.description: BackgroundValue‐based healthcare (VBHC) is a novel concept derived from economic research which is recently implemented in various medical departments and facilities. Additionally to an improvement of patient care, it postulates a reduction of expenses by providing patients with what they really need. Value in this context is defined as outcomes achieved for patients relative to the required costs.

pmc-12636538.title: The lung immune prognostic index as a predictive biomarker in urological malignancies undergoing immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy
pmc-12636538.creator: Yan He, Yuan Yuan, Xiao Wei, Lili Li, Pengcheng Luo
pmc-12636538.description: ObjectiveWe conducted a meta-analysis to evaluate the prognostic utility of the Lung Immune Prognostic Index (LIPI) in patients with urological malignancies treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs).MethodsWe systematically searched PubMed, the Cochrane Library, and EMBASE up to March 3, 2025. Clinical outcomes included overall survival (OS), progression-free survival (PFS), objective response rate (ORR), and disease control rate (DCR).

pmc-12810172.description: BackgroundOral habits are repetitive actions involving the oral cavity that can impact dental development. Among the potential consequences, malocclusion stands out as a prevalent issue.
